user_query: I want to plan a road trip across the United States and visit famous landmarks. Provide me with a list of cities along the route and their unique histories and touristic AI texts. Also, recommend hotels in each city for my stay during the road trip.

TaskList.description: Identify the major landmarks and cities to include in the road trip itinerary.
Gather unique histories and touristic AI texts for each landmark and city identified in step 1.
Recommend hotels in each city for the planned stay during the road trip.
